positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: CPI day (July CPI 8:30am ET Aug 12) — the binary macro trigger the whole tape is pinned to. But the asymmetric edge is SOL-specific: the Alpenglow upgrade — the largest consensus change in Solana's history (replaces TowerBFT/removes Proof of History, targets ~150ms and potentially ~100ms block confirmation) — is LIVE now, entering community validator testing, i.e. the catalyst the prior note flagged as '6 days out' has arrived. SOL also shows the clearest relative strength of the universe into CPI (holding ~$76.78, roughly flat, while BTC -1.7% and ETH -2.4% overnight), and SOL ETF inflows jumped to a 3-month high (~$8.8M, strongest since May 12), signaling returning institutional bid. Canonical dashboard proxy FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-12T11:53:20Z): SOL 76.78, BTC 64173.60, ETH 1913.30.
positions.driver: Closed prior BTC at 64173.60 (canonical live) vs entry 64312.90 for -23.09 (-0.22%) — BTC did exactly what the prior risk note warned: ground sideways into CPI and gave back a hair. ROTATED into SOL as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it now pairs a FRESH, live network catalyst (Alpenglow activation/validator testing) with the tape's clearest relative strength and improving ETF flows, giving asymmetric upside if CPI prints soft while the majors just tag their event-driven range. Wins vs runners-up: BTC (64173.60) is the quality/protection pick but keeps grinding out near-zero on a fear tape (as it did yesterday); ETH (1913.30) is the laggard, unable to convert inflows into price; XRP is underperforming (~-5% over the stretch) with no fresh trigger. SOL is the one name with both a catalyst that has actually landed and momentum leadership into the print.
positions.risks: Higher-beta alt into a binary macro print: a hot CPI flushes risk and SOL bleeds harder than the majors. Alpenglow is still in validator TESTING (not fully activated) so 'sell-the-news' or a delay headline could cap upside. A loss of ~$74 support opens a slide toward $72 then the low-$70s. ETF inflow revival can reverse fast. Hard stop 69.10 (-10%).
